quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #2
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 44

questions.question: What will help a person overcome the effects of alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time allows a person's body to process alcohol.

questions.question: Which statement about railroad crossings is true?

options.text: It is illegal to drive around lowered gates at a crossing.
You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger tells you to.
Not all railroad crossings have flashing red lights and gates.

questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when directed by a flagger, stop sign, or warning devices like gates or flashing lights. Not all crossings have these devices. It is illegal to drive around lowered railroad crossing gates.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers that buggies may be ahead.

questions.question: How should you avoid a truck or bus driver's blind spot?

options.text: Do not drive next to them and do not follow too closely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive next to them and do not follow too closely.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles like trucks and buses have large blind spots on their sides and back. Avoid driving next to them and do not tailgate them.

questions.question: What must a driver do to safely pass another vehicle?

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear of other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear of other cars.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look ahead to make sure no cars are coming. Turn your head briefly to check for vehicles in your blind spot and make sure you have room to move safely into the next lane.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause a crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: When the traffic light turns yellow as you approach an intersection, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get through before the red light.
Be ready to stop in the middle of the intersection.
Be ready to stop before reaching the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop before reaching the intersection.
questions.explanation: A yellow light means the light will soon turn red. Prepare to stop safely if possible.

questions.question: When pulled over for a traffic violation or equipment check, what must you show?
questions.explanation: You must have and show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance when stopped by police.

questions.question: When you hear a fire engine siren behind you, you must:

options.text: Pull to the side of the road and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear an emergency vehicle siren, move to the edge of the road and stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: The best way to avoid hydroplaning is to:

options.text: Slow down when roads are wet or slushy.
Watch out for standing water or puddles.

questions.explanation: Wet roads make it harder to stop and easier to skid. Do not use cruise control in wet or icy conditions. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: When a school bus stops with its stop arm extended, you should:

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait to proceed.
Honk your horn before passing the bus on its left.
Continue driving when you think most kids are done exiting.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait to proceed.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus shows its stop signal. Do not proceed until the stop arm is raised.

questions.question: When it starts to sleet or snow, you should:

options.text: Keep your windshield and mirrors clear.
Stay farther back from the vehicles in front of you.

questions.explanation: In snow or sleet, keep your windshield and mirrors clear. Increase your following distance because slippery roads need more space to stop.

questions.question: A person walking with a white cane or guide dog is likely to be:
questions.explanation: You must always yield to a pedestrian who is blind and using a white cane or guide dog.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: The "No zone" is:

options.text: Blind spots around a truck or bus where cars cannot be seen.
A roadway with restrictions on vehicle stereo volume.
The television show that replaced The Twilight Zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blind spots around a truck or bus where cars cannot be seen.
questions.explanation: Trucks and buses have blind spots on each side, in the rear, and in the front. Your car cannot be seen in these areas. These blind spots are called the "No zone."

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even when there is no visible traffic.
Signal only if there is visible traffic.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only when driving in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even when there is no visible traffic.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from a curb. Do not skip this step even when you think there is no traffic nearby.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with no train visible or audible, you must stop if:
questions.explanation: Stop before crossing railroad tracks if red lights are flashing, a gate is lowered, a stop sign is posted, a flagger signals you to stop, or a train is near. When in doubt, stop. Never race a train.

questions.question: To check your blind spot before changing lanes:

options.text: Look into the left side mirror.
Look into the right side mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.
questions.explanation: To check your blind spot, look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.

questions.question: When you see a steady red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Drive through if there is no crossing traffic.
Continue driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.

questions.explanation: A steady red light means you must stop completely. Driving through a red light is illegal and dangerous. You may turn right on red only if no sign prohibits it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: When driving on wet pavement, remember:

options.text: Roads are most slippery right after rain starts.

questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery. A thin layer of water, oil, and dirt covers the pavement. Slow down when there is heavy rain or standing water to keep your tires from losing grip.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: You hear a siren behind you. What should you do?

options.text: Pull over to the right and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights behind you, pull over to the right side of the road and stop. If you are in heavy traffic, move slowly until you can get out of the way.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle is coming with flashing red or blue lights. What should you do?

options.text: Try to reach your destination before it catches up.
Keep driving and try to stay out of its way.
Pull over to the side of the road and stop completely.
Stop in the middle of an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the side of the road and stop completely.
questions.explanation: You must yield to emergency vehicles with sirens or flashing lights. Pull over to the right edge of the road. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first, then pull over.

questions.question: Braking distance is affected by:

options.text: How fast your vehicle is going.
The condition of your brakes and tires.

questions.explanation: Braking distance depends on your speed, the condition of your brakes and tires, and the condition of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction to drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that penalties are higher for unsafe driving in work zones.

questions.question: When can a driver legally pass on the right side of another vehicle?

options.text: When the vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is an available passing lane.
Even if you have to drive off the pavement.

questions.correctAnswerText: When the vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is an available passing lane.
questions.explanation: You may pass on the right of a vehicle waiting to turn left if there is an available passing lane. You may also pass on the right on a multilane road with two or more lanes going the same direction. Never drive off the pavement to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they can turn right or go straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What is important when changing lanes?

options.text: Make sure the lane is clear before you enter it.

questions.explanation: Signal for a good amount of time before changing lanes. Turn your head and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before moving right or left.

questions.question: If a police officer is directing traffic at a working traffic light, what should drivers do?

options.text: Watch what the cars next to you are doing.

questions.explanation: Traffic signals help prevent crashes and keep traffic moving. Drivers must obey signals, but when an officer is directing traffic, follow the officer's directions instead.

questions.question: How should you merge into a busy freeway?

options.text: Use your mirrors and check your blind spots.
Use the entrance ramp to match the speed of freeway traffic.
Yield to traffic already on the freeway.

questions.explanation: Speed up on the entrance ramp to match freeway traffic and yield to cars already on the freeway. Check your mirrors and blind spots to make sure you have room to merge safely.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They warn drivers about hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: This shape and color sign is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign only means a no passing zone ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of what?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is coming.

questions.question: What should you do when you are in a travel lane on the road?

options.text: You may stop to drop off passengers.
You may stop to look up an address.
You may make a U-turn or back up if you miss a freeway entrance.
Do not stop. Keep driving until you can safely pull off the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not stop. Keep driving until you can safely pull off the road.
questions.explanation: Never stop in a travel lane. Keep moving until you can safely leave the road. If you miss your exit, go to the next one or find a safe place to turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do. When you see this sign, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does an orange sign mean?

options.text: The start of a no passing zone.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction, maintenance, and emergency work. They have black symbols on orange backgrounds.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign tells you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does a flashing red light mean?

options.text: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
Look both ways and then proceed.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must make a complete stop before entering the intersection. You may only proceed when the intersection is clear and you will not block traffic crossing from other directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to turn right or left.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Turn on your low beam headlights.
Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Do not drive faster than 10 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: You must use headlights when you cannot see 500 feet ahead. Use low beams in fog or rain. High beams reflect light back into your eyes and make it harder to see.

questions.question: What can impair a person's ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires the driver to be healthy and alert. Alcohol, legal and illegal drugs, and tiredness can all impair your ability to drive.

questions.question: When driving in fog, what should you do?

options.text: Do not use high beam headlights.
Use low beam headlights to see the road and objects better.

questions.explanation: Fog makes it hard to see other vehicles, pedestrians, and traffic signals. Slow down and drive carefully. Do not use high beams. Low beams help you see better in fog.

questions.question: What happens if you drink alcohol while taking medicine?

options.text: The medicine reduces the effect of the alcohol.
The alcohol helps the medicine work better.
The effects of both can be stronger together.
There is no effect because they are different.

questions.correctAnswerText: The effects of both can be stronger together.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol and medicine can increase how much they affect you. For example, one drink with a cold medicine can affect you as much as several drinks alone would.

questions.question: Before changing lanes on a highway, you should:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Look in your rearview and side mirrors to see if anyone is passing you. Turn your head to check your blind spot to make sure no one is there before you change lanes.
